criteria.none: The statements given do not settle the page's rights: nothing was fetched from a host that does not settle them itself, or the statements are too thin to tell
criteria.open-licence: An open licence covers the page's text: Creative Commons BY or BY-SA, CC0 or public domain, stated in the page's licence metadata, its own rights statement or an open-access record
criteria.public-cite-only: The page is free to read without a login or payment, from an extension service, arboretum, botanic garden, university, government body or reference site, and states no open licence for its text; its numbers can be cited with no text reproduced
criteria.restricted: The page is behind a login, paywall or subscription, sits on a social network (whether or not it could be fetched), or its terms forbid reuse or citation of its content
